review: Keep ordinary success, failure, cancellation, and repeated-call controls, including actions created after cancellation. Trace each distinct creation through use and cleanup. Cite where references are captured or resolved later, state the starting objects and event order, and attribute each check and effect to the object it reaches. Distinguish return values, their causes, and when deferred work starts or finishes. Where permitted, test unchanged identity, copying, replacement, wrapper or key mutation, and caller-local rebinding separately. Verify identity with evidence beyond matching generation values and account for stable captures and identity guards. Cite documented exclusions and mark unanswered policy questions OPEN.
